title: A New Routine
content:
On Monday morning, Clara woke up feeling tired. She had spent the weekend watching movies and staying up late, and now she was already thinking about how difficult the week was going to be.

She looked at the clock and quickly got out of bed.

—I’m going to be late for work!

Clara got dressed, made a quick breakfast, and left the house. However, when she reached the bus stop, she realized that she had forgotten her phone at home.

—I’m going to have to go back.

She returned home, picked up her phone, and hurried back to the bus stop. Fortunately, the bus arrived a few minutes later.

At work, Clara had several things to do. She was going to attend a meeting in the morning, finish a report in the afternoon, and organize some documents before leaving.

During lunch, her friend Sophie noticed that Clara looked exhausted.

—You don’t look very well. Are you okay?

—I’m just tired. I’ve been sleeping badly lately.

—You’re going to feel worse if you don’t change your routine.

Clara knew Sophie was right. She had been spending too much time on her phone at night and rarely exercised.

—You know what? I’m going to change my routine this week.

—Really? What are you going to do?

—I’m going to go to bed earlier, I’m going to start walking every morning, and I’m going to spend less time on my phone before bed.

That evening, Clara went home and prepared everything for the next morning. She put her running shoes beside the door and set her alarm for six thirty.

—I’m going to start tomorrow —she said with a smile.

The next morning, getting up was difficult, but Clara didn't give up. She went for a twenty-minute walk before work.

It wasn't a big change, but it was a beginning.

Over the next few days, Clara slowly became more organized. She was going to bed earlier, preparing her meals in advance, and making time for exercise.

By Friday, she felt more energetic.

When Sophie saw her at work, she smiled.

—You look much better!

—I feel much better too. I think I’m going to keep this routine.

—Good! And what are you going to do this weekend?

Clara laughed.

—I’m going to relax. But this time, I’m going to sleep early!
